scope: Mock-DOM readiness benchmarks, keyboard accessibility, GIF source lifecycle, reduced motion and optional navigation callback.

results.name: Readiness starts at TRL 2 as a provisional integration self-assessment
Browsing all nine benchmarks never raises the current rating or claims future completion
Invalid readiness values leave selection and the current system rating intact
Readiness keyboard browsing supports arrows, wrapping, Home and End with focus
Visible animation starts with GIF and unchanged state avoids source reload
User pause survives hidden, offscreen, and Studio round trips until explicit play
GIF pauses independently for hidden page, Studio tab and offscreen state, resuming only when all clear
Reduced motion starts paused and enabling the preference stops GIF without automatic restart
Animation disposal disconnects its observer and optional APIs/elements are safe
Optional navigation callback reports default and tab transitions before 3D import resolves
